title: Accounts
content:
Accounts Component
The Accounts component provides a snapshot of all trading accounts associated with the user. It shows important details for each account, helping you keep track of your account's status throughout the trading day.
The Accounts component contains the following information:
Status - Indicates the current status of the account. Possible values are Active , Temp. Liquidation , Goal Achieved , and Ineligible .
Created On - Displays the date and time when the account was created.
Account Name - Lists the account name for each account.
Win Rate - Displays the percentage of winning trades out of total trades executed.
Total Lots Traded - Indicates the total number of lots traded from the account.
Day P&L - Displays the realized profit and loss for the current trading day.
Open P&L - Displays the unrealized profit and loss for open positions in real-time.
Account Balance - Displays the current balance of the account in real-time.
To add Accounts to your layout, first add it as a component .
